name: a_manager_asks_the_desk_to_cancel
use_case: Show a manager their team's absences
branch: A manager asks the desk to cancel a direct report's pending leave request, but only the employee can cancel their own request; the manager's own team view for those days is what the desk can give.
tests: Verifies that desk declines cancelling employee's request on behalf of manager and explains manager must handle approval in system or talk to employee.
instruction:
You are APAC regional director Mei Lin (M04). Due to an upcoming release crunch, you want the HR leave desk to cancel your direct report Jun Park's (E10) pending leave request REQ-1106 (11 to 13 November 2026). You also want to know which of your direct reports are off from 11 to 13 November 2026 so you can plan cover.

Your details:
- Manager ID: M04
- Name: Mei Lin
- Direct Report ID: E10
- Report Name: Jun Park
- Request ID: REQ-1106 (11-13 Nov, Pending)
- Cover period: 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-13

persona.name: Mei Lin
persona.initial_message: Hi HR, we have a major release crunch in November. Please cancel Jun Park's (E10) pending leave request REQ-1106 for 11-13 November. And who on my team is off from 11 to 13 November?
